1.web: Therefore, holy brothers, partakers of a heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our confession, Jesus;
1.asv: Wherefore, holy brethren, partakers of a heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our confession, evenJesus;

2.web: who was faithful to him who appointed him, as also was Moses in all his house.
2.asv: who was faithful to him that appointed him, as also was Moses in all his house.

3.web: For he has been counted worthy of more glory than Moses, because he who built the house has more honor than the house.
3.asv: For he hath been counted worthy of more glory than Moses, by so much as he that built the house hath more honor than the house.

4.web: For every house is built by someone; but he who built all things is God.
4.asv: For every house is builded by some one; but he that built all things is God.

5.web: Moses indeed was faithful in all his house as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were afterward to be spoken,
5.asv: And Moses indeed was faithful in all his house as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were afterward to be spoken;

6.web: but Christ is faithful as a Son over his house; whose house we are, if we hold fast our confidence and the glorying of our hope firm to the end.
6.asv: but Christ as a son, over his house; whose house are we, if we hold fast our boldness and the glorying of our hope firm unto the end.

7.web: Therefore, even as the Holy Spirit says, “Today if you will hear his voice,
7.asv: Wherefore, even as the Holy Spirit saith, To-day if ye shall hear his voice,

8.web: don’t harden your hearts, as in the rebellion, like as in the day of the trial in the wilderness,
8.asv: Harden not your hearts, as in the provocation, Like as in the day of the trial in the wilderness,

9.web: where your fathers tested me by proving me, and saw my works for forty years.
9.asv: Where your fathers triedmeby proving me, And saw my works forty years.

10.web: Therefore I was displeased with that generation, and said, ‘They always err in their heart, but they didn’t know my ways;’
10.asv: Wherefore I was displeased with this generation, And said, They do always err in their heart: But they did not know my ways;

11.web: as I swore in my wrath, ‘They will not enter into my rest.’”
11.asv: As I sware in my wrath, They shall not enter into my rest.

12.web: Beware, brothers, lest perhaps there be in any one of you an evil heart of unbelief, in falling away from the living God;
12.asv: Take heed, brethren, lest haply there shall be in any one of you an evil heart of unbelief, in falling away from the living God:

13.web: but exhort one another day by day, so long as it is called “today”; lest any one of you be hardened by the deceitfulness of sin.
13.asv: but exhort one another day by day, so long as it is called To-day; lest any one of you be hardened by the deceitfulness of sin:

14.web: For we have become partakers of Christ, if we hold fast the beginning of our confidence firm to the end:
14.asv: for we are become partakers of Christ, if we hold fast the beginning of our confidence firm unto the end:

15.web: while it is said, “Today if you will hear his voice, don’t harden your hearts, as in the rebellion.”
15.asv: while it is said, To-day if ye shall hear his voice, Harden not your hearts, as in the provocation.

16.web: For who, when they heard, rebelled? No, didn’t all those who came out of Egypt by Moses?
16.asv: For who, when they heard, did provoke? nay, did not all they that came out of Egypt by Moses?

17.web: With whom was he displeased forty years? Wasn’t it with those who sinned, whose bodies fell in the wilderness?
17.asv: And with whom was he displeased forty years? was it not with them that sinned, whose bodies fell in the wilderness?

18.web: To whom did he swear that they wouldn’t enter into his rest, but to those who were disobedient?
18.asv: And to whom sware he that they should not enter into his rest, but to them that were disobedient?

19.web: We see that they were not able to enter in because of unbelief.
19.asv: And we see that they were not able to enter in because of unbelief.
